title: A person to ask IPMA about its radar image, and to register at EUMETSAT
summary: Name a person to ask IPMA whether we may load its radar image and logo, and to register at EUMETSAT's user portal for Meteosat images (free). The messages can be drafted; a person sends.
closes: A named person; then IPMA's and EUMETSAT's answers.
blocks: No radar or satellite image on the site (design rule 9): text links only.
